sourceText:
Zucchini Appetizers
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:26am

Ingredients




3 cups thinly-sliced unpared zucchini
1 cup Bisquick Original baking mix
1/2 cup finely-chopped onion
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt
1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram or oregano leaves
1 dsh freshly-ground black pepper
1 garlic clove finely chopped
1/2 cup vegetable oil
4 eggs slightly beaten

Preparation

1 Heat oven to 350 degrees. Grease bottom and sides of rectangular pan, 13 by 9 by 2 inches. 2 Stir together all ingredients. Spread in pan. Bake about 25 minutes or until golden brown. 3 Cut into 2-inch squares; cut squares diagonally in half into triangles. 4 This recipe yields 4 dozen.
